crossRefs.note: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of…
He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and…
He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
